I’m interested in what makes things work — and how to make them work better.

I’m pursuing a BS in Information Technology at Central Bicol State University of Agriculture–Sipocot, with graduation expected in June 2027. My focus is backend development: APIs, databases, and the logic that connects an application.

Beyond code, I enjoy traditional art, charcoal portrait drawing, and video editing. That creative side brings patience and attention to detail to the way I approach problems.
